items.text: An identified App candidate can use the selected native Codex MCP or CLI boundary to inspect and submit against a catalog-derived host interface while preserving operation identity, availability reason, read standing and original inspected basis under the consumed contracts; its evidence states whether the host endpoint is actual or simulated. Verifies REQ-001 via VER-001. Sources: SOW-148, SOW-183; accepted DEL-03-03; consolidated V4-ARC-21 and V4-HI-10…12,50.

verification.text: Examine native-tool configuration/adapter wiring and exercise catalog inspection, a declared non-mutating read/check and proposal submission using an identified endpoint or explicit fixture. Compare identity, availability, standing and original basis with App DEL-03-01/02 contract expectations; record each source and candidate. Evaluates AC-001.

items.text: Disabled access produces an explicit disabled result and no host request; after actual person enablement, endpoint or operation unavailability remains explicit, with the catalog's reason preserved where supplied. Local access remains within the machine boundary and enablement supplies no additional autonomy or data-destination grant. Verifies REQ-002 via VER-002. Sources: SOW-184; accepted DEL-03-03; consolidated V4-HI-04,40,52 and PRD V4-HOST-02.

verification.text: Exercise disabled, person-enabled and enabled-but-unavailable cases; inspect local configuration/request destinations and actual grant accounting. Confirm no host call while disabled, truthful unavailability and no implicit remote/data/autonomy expansion. Mark a fixture's reach and leave actual host local-operation traffic examination to its responsible joined examination. Evaluates AC-002.

items.text: Under an identified adopted operation policy, the external request follows the shared host validation/application route and distinguishes granted direct operation, proposal-only behavior, reserved human acts and workflow checkpoints without a second host mutation path or invented policy decision. Verifies REQ-003 via VER-003. Sources: SOW-183; consolidated V4-HI-20…23,30…42,50…51.

verification.text: Against identified adopted policy, exercise permitted direct operation, proposal-only, reserved-act refusal and checkpoint wait. Trace the receiver's route to the shared host contract, including refusal, and inspect App code/configuration for a bypass route; use external host evidence for host enforcement claims. Evaluates AC-003 without deciding the policy.

items.text: Consumer fixtures preserve stale refusal/reason, original target under later selection, the shared duplicate one-effect contract, and unknown outcome after an unobserved acknowledgment; they do not claim local transport behavior proves the host's durable outcome. Verifies REQ-004 via VER-004. Sources: SOW-183; App DEL-03-02 interface; consolidated V4-HI-23 and V4-EXM-25.

verification.text: Inject an intervening edit, later selection, duplicate submission and lost acknowledgment/interruption into external consumer fixtures. Compare expected preserved basis/target and stale/duplicate/unknown outcomes with App DEL-03-02; identify actual versus simulated host receipts and defer durable joined conclusions to App DEL-09-09. Evaluates AC-004.

items.text: Human-act fixtures reject fabricated attribution from success, queued status or receipts alone and positively preserve an actually performed, content-bound human act with decision actor distinct from recorder; separately evidenced checking, approval or reliance is neither inferred nor erased nor made contingent on unrelated edit acceptance. Verifies REQ-004 via VER-005. Sources: SOW-183; consolidated V4-HI-25,30…33 and PRD V4-AUT-03…05; Composite decision 03.

verification.text: Inspect received human-act mapping and exercise fabrication negatives plus a positive case of an actually performed human act recorded with actor, relevant content identity and evidence distinct from recorder. Check that execution, edit acceptance, checking, approval and reliance retain their separate standing, including independently evidenced acts without an edit-acceptance predecessor. Evaluates AC-005.

items.text: The enablement/interface documentation names every excluded act's actual owner, the consumed contracts and adopted policy inputs, exact open-issue owners and points of need, and the external contribution needed for App DEL-09-09; it retains open transport, authentication and schema details without adding wire fields, a common service or host-delivery claims. Verifies REQ-005 and REQ-006 via VER-006. Sources: SOW-148, SOW-183, SOW-184; accepted DEL-03-03 DOC artifact; CLM-001…CLM-004 and the open matters below.

verification.text: Review documentation against the accepted DEL-03-03 artifact/interface/owner row, Group3 PKG-03/04, OI-001/002/003/013/014/021 and DEP-001, current source qualifications, CLM-001…CLM-004 and each open matter below. Check excluded acts one-for-one, local/privacy and grant limits, exact unresolved ownership/timing, and no inferred host delivery or new technical choice. Evaluates AC-006.

items.text: The external consumer fixture set covers AC-001…AC-005 with candidate/contract/policy identities, outcomes and evidence limits and identifies the App contribution available to the later joined inspection-to-receipt witness; generated versus additional adapter work and unresolved extension standing remain explicit. Verifies REQ-006 via VER-007. Sources: SOW-148, SOW-183, SOW-184; accepted DEL-03-03 TEST artifact; App DEL-09-09 interface; consolidated V4-EXM-24…25.

verification.text: Inspect the fixture inventory, results and receiving handoff for complete AC-001…AC-005 coverage, candidate/contract/policy identities, original-basis/outcome evidence and explicit simulation/host limits. Check App DEL-09-09's required join remains separate and that generated/adapted work does not settle automatic extension. Evaluates AC-007.
